name: app-banking-research-insight-cards-slide
title: Banking Research Insight Cards
whatItIs: A pale case-study slide with a light sans and navy italic serif headline, and three staggered white cards each posing a question with a giant percentage and a hatched progress bar or day chart.
whatItMeans: Big light numerals and hatched bars make data feel elegant and calm. The stagger keeps a simple slide from feeling like a table.
techniques: Mixing a light sans with an italic serif in one headline
Oversized thin numerals paired with tiny captions
Hatched bar fills with a floating percentage bubble
Cards staggered at different heights and offsets
Single navy hue for all data

vocabulary.definition: A bar filled with fine diagonal or vertical lines instead of solid color.
Combining different typeface styles within one headline.
A card built around one big number and its caption.
